research.searchCoverage: Official AnySearch REST search is POST https://api.anysearch.com/v1/search with Bearer API key, billed against the authenticated quota. Pinned credential validator uses that billed search. HTTP 200 bodies use numeric code 0 for success. MCP JSON-RPC tools (get_sub_domains, batch_search, extract) are omitted. Legal-entity HQ was not identified. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying AnySearch platform compromise.
remainingGates: healthcheck: no cheap account/status/quota GET in pinned actions; official credential validator is billed POST /v1/search (402 quota is treated as authenticated); billable search is not used as healthcheck
HTTP 200 false-success: REST envelope uses numeric code 0 for success and non-zero for failure; native bodyErrorPaths treats any finite number as an error so code cannot be used
MCP JSON-RPC tools/call at /mcp (get_sub_domains, batch_search, extract) and batch_search fanout are unsupported native semantics
operator HQ / legal entity was not identified in bounded 2026-09-13 coverage

adaptations: HOLD: billed search is not admitted as healthcheck. Native search maps to documented POST /v1/search with required query and optional max_results.
Authorization is Bearer {{apiKey}} matching official docs and the pinned runtime.
domain/tag/content_types/zone/language/params are omitted so the native body stays the documented query example.
HTTP 200 bodies with code !== 0 cannot be demoted: bodyErrorPaths would treat success code 0 as an error because it is a number.
MCP JSON-RPC tools are omitted. Returns raw AnySearch JSON under data. The upstream user-agent and x-anysearch-client header are not sent on this REST path.
